⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The electric oven fails to reach temperature (broil works on top, but the bottom stays lukewarm) or beeps loudly showing F10 or F30 on the clock display.

Verified technical root cause: For 'no heat on Bake', the lower 2600W 316075103 bake heating element has blistered and burned open; for F10 / F30 codes, the 316233902 stainless temperature sensor probe has drifted out of resistance (~1080 Ohms at room temp).

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Flip the 240V range circuit breaker off.
  2. Look inside the bottom of the oven cavity at the black tubular heating loop (316075103): if you see a blister, crack, or white powder spot, or if it fails continuity, remove the two 1/4-inch mounting screws at the back wall, pull the terminals forward, and swap in the new element.
  3. If the display beeps F10 or F30, unscrew the two screws holding the thin metal sensor pencil (316233902) in the upper left corner of the oven cavity and plug in the new sensor.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Error F10 / F30 / Oven Not Heating)

Can I replace the 316075103 bake element from inside the oven without pulling the stove out from the wall?
Yes! As long as you turn off the breaker first and gently pull the two wire spade connectors through the back slots without letting them slip back into the insulation, the entire swap is done from inside the open oven door in 10 minutes.
